name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Discovery Lead | Requirements Gathering, Client Consulting, Data Files & Process Improvement
summary: Implementation lead who owns discovery: gathering and finalizing requirements, consulting clients on best practices, and handing off a clean build. At Accelo I scoped implementations of a complex CRM, project, and billing platform and built the sequenced plans the delivery team executed. At Wix I launched 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets and coached onboarding teams of up to 30. I set up and validate data feeds myself and work hands-on in Excel.

experience.title: Implementation Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Run discovery with business owners and staff to gather requirements, document goals and rules, and translate them into tailored system configuration.
Set up and validate data feeds into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, re-checking every import before go-live.
Consult clients on best practices and recommend system improvements based on how their business actually operates.
Document every requirement, decision, and deliverable, keeping records auditable for the team that supports the client after launch.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Onboarded and trained 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors across teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Implemented and launched 25+ clients per month with up to ~25 concurrent onboardings, holding 110% of implementation targets.
Led onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training and 1:1 coaching, and helped hire and train new team members.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order.
Advised clients on best practices and walked them through invoicing and billing workflows before go-live.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk during setup.
